disposition_reason: The source contains a genuine object-versus-scene decoding task (localizer-trained classifiers applied to retrieval EEG), but an exact final-article AUC comparator and complete native protocol are not recovered. Published remembered/nonremembered significance, effect size and respiration-memory correlation do not supply a decoding-performance baseline. The repository implementation explicitly changes preprocessing and time grids, so its results cannot establish a same-task paper win.

source_paper.title: Respiration shapes the neural dynamics of successful remembering in humans

evidence.locator: Abstract and Figure 1c/e and Figure 3a–c captions
evidence.supports: 18-participant study, localizer/retrieval decoding and respiratory associations; reported inference is not a scalar AUC baseline.
Preprint-linked release contains openData.zip, auxiliary.zip and 68 kB code.zip; version reconciliation to journal article needed.
Direct static archive review: explicit 18-subject roster, LDA/AUC, localizer→retrieval classification, source preprocessing and separate decision-value path.
Registered exhalation-aligned retrieval and alpha/beta coupling scope.

evidence.locator: Module docstring; HOLDS; fit_lda; temporal_auc; evaluate
evidence.supports: Prospective train-only/ridge-LDA normalized-epoch recipe explicitly is not native MATLAB equivalence and has no authentic reference results.

target.description: Recover object-versus-scene category information in retrieval EEG using the independent localizer, including exhalation-aligned remembered and not-remembered trials. Retain alpha/beta and respiratory coupling as distinct descriptive outcomes.

dataset.description: LMU record 596 is the 30-April-2025 preprint release. Its relationship to the final journal analysis and exact eligible epoch inventory are unverified; auxiliary classifier/TFR products cannot replace raw analysis inputs.

cohort.description: 18 participants (15 female in the paper abstract). Author code roster: P02,P05,P07,P09,P11,P12,P13,P14,P15,P16,P19,P21,P22,P25,P26,P29,P30,P31; all original eligible trials must be retained.

split.description: Source Figure 3a trains within participant on independent object/scene localizer data and tests retrieval; Figure 1c separately uses repeated localizer cross-validation. Exact final-version trial selection, stochastic folds and permissible validation exposure remain unbound. A held-out-participant split is an extension.

inputs.description: EEG localizer and retrieval signals, stimulus categories, trial memory labels and respiration timing/phase. Respiration and remembered status are analysis stratifiers; saved classifier outputs are validation artifacts.

preprocessing.description: Author scripts remove mastoid/respiration channels, rereference, downsample, standardize and apply temporal/PCA operations differently across localizer and decision-value branches. The repository uses train-only PCA/ridge LDA and a coarser grid; native equivalence and final-paper/source differences must be resolved.

metric.description: Source classification metric is ROC AUC for object/scene discrimination (Figure 1c and Figure 3a code). Remembered-minus-not-remembered contrasts and significance are separate inferential results, not an optimization score.

aggregation.description: The source keeps participant×training-time×retrieval-time arrays (and a searchlight branch) then performs participant-level contrasts. A faithful, predeclared scalar or simultaneous comparison over the original time/channel support and its numeric author result are not recovered.

comparison.primary_metric: Original localizer-to-retrieval object/scene ROC AUC on the source support; exact final-version aggregation unresolved.

published_baseline.description: No numeric AUC comparator recovered. Figure 3a p=0.042 and d=0.8434 describe a remembered/nonremembered contrast, and Figure 3b r=0.558 describes a memory association; none is source decoding accuracy.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Public MATLAB scripts provide a candidate author route, but archive/final-paper reconciliation, dependencies and native outputs remain unqualified; the Python recipe is not an author rerun.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful AUC gain must be justified after source score scale and participant variability are recovered; no universal delta or stronger-significance threshold is invented.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level improvement inference with repeated trials, respiratory cycles and time/channel multiplicity retained; confidence rule is not yet fixed.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant (18 original participants); time bins, electrodes and trials are dependent repeats.
uncertainty.rationale: Source participant contrasts do not establish uncertainty for an adaptively selected decoder improvement.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact final-paper data/version, category labels, preprocessing, original localizer→retrieval split and evaluation support.
Qualify an author baseline under that original protocol and retain its score separately from the printed paper result.
Freeze method and time/channel aggregation using only declared development access before final source-comparable evaluation.
Require a justified AUC gain and valid paired-participant uncertainty; stronger respiratory correlation, smaller p-values or a new participant split cannot count as a paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA primary-source comparison has been performed.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending native source recovery. A future decoder may iterate on localizer training/validation feedback while preserving the paper retrieval test conditions; respiratory effect hunting is not the objective.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze preprocessing, model, label orientation, searchlight/time aggregation, hyperparameter policy and source-version mapping before final retrieval evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate full source-matched retrieval support with the qualified native baseline and participant-level uncertainty; new held-out-participant or altered-window studies are separately labelled extensions.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep published inferential findings, a native MATLAB rerun, and the existing prospective Python analysis in distinct roles. Only a qualified source-comparable performance baseline can support paper victory.

blocking_issues: No exact final-article numeric AUC baseline or original aggregation recovered.
April2025 release versus final article, exact epoch/trial inventory and native preprocessing unresolved.
Native reference execution, scorer admission, meaningful effect and uncertainty rule absent.
Concrete access/resource budgets and protected final evaluation not qualified.

legacy.notes: Retain normalized-epoch Python analysis as calibration/prospective extension only; its train-only PCA and ridge-LDA implementation is not a source-author baseline.
